typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		OPPORTUNITY_ID as string,
		KPIT_REQUEST_DT as string,
		INVENTORY_ID as string,
		MAIL_ADDR1 as string,
		MAIL_ADDR2 as string,
		MAIL_CITY as string,
		MAIL_STATE as string,
		MAIL_ZIP as string,
		MAIL_ZIP4 as string,
		FILE_NAME as string,
		ADFId__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['curated/ib_kpma_fulfillment*']) ~> curatedRaw
source(output(
		Id as string,
		ADFId__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/fulfillment_orders_id.csv']) ~> fulfillmentOrderId
curatedRaw select(mapColumn(
		OTN__c = INVENTORY_ID,
		ADFId__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
fulfillmentOrderId, Select1 join(fulfillmentOrderId@ADFId__c == Select1@ADFId__c,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
Join1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c = fulfillmentOrderId@ADFId__c,
		Fulfillment_Order__c = Id,
		OTN__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['insert_Fulfillment_Orders_Line_Items__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertOrderItems
